title: Questmark options header
description: The JSON object in the indented code block under the QUESTMARK-OPTIONS-HEADER heading.

initial-state.description: Name of the state entered first.

initial-context.description: Initial context values. Keys are names; values must be strings or numbers.

no_link_behaviour.description: What happens after an option with no link is chosen.

whitespace.description: Use source text for each node (entities and literal backslashes preserved).

emit_on.description: Emit on every text node, or only when a line ends.

strip_leading_newlines.description: Strip leading newlines from emitted text chunks.
